cash_gaps.title: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(net_ngn), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn FROM becuz.transfer_check
WHERE bank_txn_id IS NULL AND CAST(sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
evidence.summary: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank: -25,670

check.note: The re-check matched: 25,670 naira from 6 records. 6 records back this.

summary.what_happened: Profit in these 7 days was ₦337,414, which is ₦1,462 more than usual (₦335,952).
why: Profit went up, and none of the problems Becuz checks for showed up in these 7 days.
cash: ₦25,670 from 6 transfer sales was recorded at the till but never reached the bank. The sales still count toward your profit, but this money is missing from your account.
summary.outcome: Profit is on track; chasing the 6 missing transfers brings ₦25,670 back into your account.

what_to_do.action: Check these transfers against the bank app with the staff who recorded them.
